title: Feed Your Faith With Healing Scriptures (Matthew 4:4) | Pastor Jesse Rich
desc: Pastor Jesse teaches from Matthew 4:4 that believers must feed their faith on God's Word every day, especially when believing God for healing. He walks through Proverbs 4:20-22 and compares Scripture to the label on a prescription, with instructions to follow. He explains from Matthew 7 that the person who hears and acts on the Word stands through the storm. He also shares why healing comes by faith, like salvation, and tells of a time he lay paralyzed in a hospital. The message closes with a prayer for healing and an invitation to receive Jesus as Lord.
topic: Feed Your Faith With Healing Scriptures

chapters.label: God's Word Is Like a Prescription

title: Tuesday Service 11/3/26: Decree and Declare Your Covenant of Prosperity
desc: Pastor Jesse opens in 3 John 2 and shows from John 10:10, Mark 10:29-30, Psalm 35:27 and 2 Corinthians 8:9 that God's will includes provision and health for His children. He explains how he took 3 John 2 as his own verse and began speaking it daily, with worship and thanksgiving. From Psalm 103 he teaches that angels respond to God's Word spoken in faith. He encourages listeners to feed their faith with scripture, take authority over lack and sickness right away, and keep praising God. The message closes with Romans 10 and a prayer for anyone who wants to receive Jesus as Lord.
topic: Decree and Declare Your Covenant of Prosperity

title: Sunday Service 11/1/26: Feed Your Faith: Stay Built Up on God's Word
desc: Pastor Jesse teaches that faith is fed by continually hearing God's word, and that we should never assume we've already heard it. He shows how to back up every prayer for healing or finances with scripture, so you know you are praying God's will. Using John 15, Matthew 18:19, and James 1, he explains how to stand your ground after you pray, thank God instead of asking again, and answer doubt with the word. He encourages a daily habit of reading and studying, with a healing devotional as a practical tool, and closes with an invitation to receive Jesus as Lord and a prayer for those watching. Scriptures: Romans 10:17, John 15:7, Matthew 18:19, James 1:5-8.
topic: Feed Your Faith: Stay Built Up on God's Word

chapters.label: Standing on Your Prayer of Agreement
Being a Doer of the Word

title: Tuesday Service 10/20/26: Stay Thankful: Remember What God Has Done
desc: Pastor Jesse continues the Gospel of John series in chapter 6 and shows what Jesus did when He faced a need: He gave thanks before the miracle came. He pairs it with Matthew 16, where the disciples forgot what God had just done and fell into worry. Pastor Jesse encourages believers to stop and remember what God has done for them, from healing to deliverance, and to turn their worries into thanksgiving. He shares stories of pastors who stayed grateful and generous and saw God take care of them. The message closes with a clear invitation to receive Jesus as Lord and Savior. Scriptures: John 6:5-13, Matthew 16:7-10, Romans 10:9-10, 1 Thessalonians 5:18.
topic: Stay Thankful: Remember What God Has Done

title: Tuesday Service 10/13/26: Use Your Authority: Speak to Your Mountain
desc: Pastor Jesse opens in Matthew 18:18 and Philippians 2 to show that believers have been given the name of Jesus and real authority over the devil. He teaches that we are to speak to our problems, not just talk to God about them, and to keep standing on our confession of faith as Jesus did in Matthew 17:20. He shows from James 2 that faith has to be put to work, and he points to Caleb as an example of speaking boldly about the mountain instead of complaining about it. He then warns about the cost of judging others and talking against ministers, and shares a personal story of choosing to give and pray instead. The message closes with an invitation to receive Jesus as Lord and a prayer of salvation.
topic: Use Your Authority: Speak to Your Mountain

title: Sunday Service 10/11/26: Follow the Spirit Within and Obey God Now
desc: Pastor Rich opens with Jesus in Gethsemane and Romans 8:14, then moves to the parable of the rich fool in Luke 12. He shows how the man planned only for his own comfort and never sought God. Pastor Rich teaches that believers are meant to be led by the Spirit and to obey the inward witness right away, whether that means giving, serving, or following a call. He shares stories from his own life, including his early years in church and a newspaper route he almost quit, to show why we should stay hungry for God. The message closes with an invitation to receive Jesus as Lord and Savior. Scriptures: Luke 12:16-21, Luke 4:1, Ecclesiastes 11:1-4, Romans 8:14.
topic: Follow the Spirit Within and Obey God Now

title: Tuesday Service 10/6/26: Take Authority Over Satan: Hold Fast Your Confession
desc: Pastor Jesse walks through the key scriptures on binding and loosing, including Matthew 12, 16 and 18, Mark 16, Luke 10 and Philippians 2, to show how believers can exercise the authority Jesus gave them. He shares how he used those verses on his job and finances during a hard season, and how he speaks to pain in Jesus' name until it leaves. From 1 Timothy 4, he explains why it matters to hold fast your confession of faith and not be talked out of it by seducing spirits. He also encourages speaking strength over your body, staying thankful with a spirit of victory, and making your mouth work for you in praise. The service closes with a prayer to receive Jesus as Lord. Scriptures: Matthew 18:18, Mark 16:17-18, Luke 13:16, 1 Timothy 4:1.
topic: Take Authority Over Satan: Hold Fast Your Confession

title: Sunday Service 10/4/26: Speak to Your Mountain: Mark 11:23 Faith
desc: Pastor Jesse teaches from Mark 11:23 that Jesus told us to speak to our mountains, not only pray about them. He connects James 3 and the power of the tongue, showing why we should watch our words and also command sickness, fear and lack to go in Jesus' name. He shares his own testimony of attending church without ever confessing Jesus as Lord, then walks through Romans 10:9-10 on salvation by confession. He encourages believers to give and receive in faith, to keep thanking God, and to hold onto childlike faith. The message closes with an invitation to receive Jesus as Lord and a prayer.
topic: Speak to Your Mountain: Mark 11:23 Faith
